description: This Go source file defines a REST storage provider for Kubernetes coordination resources, including methods to initialize storage for different API versions and resources like leases and lease candidates.

classes.name: RESTStorageProvider
classes.description: Provides REST storage for coordination API resources across different versions.

methods.name: NewRESTStorage
methods.description: Creates new REST storage configuration for the API group, supporting multiple versions.

methods.name: v1Storage
methods.description: Initializes storage for v1 API resources, such as leases.

methods.name: v1beta1Storage
methods.description: Initializes storage for v1beta1 API resources, such as lease candidates.

methods.name: v1alpha2Storage
methods.description: Initializes storage for v1alpha2 API resources, such as lease candidates.

methods.name: GroupName
methods.description: Returns the API group name for coordination resources.
